specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of Creation and God’s commandments
specific_competences.specific_competence: Use the Book of Genesis to learn about creation, responsibility and taking care of life
learning_activities: (a) Explain the concept of the Bible and Bible Knowledge
(b) Classify the books in the Bible
(c) Explain the concept of the Book of Genesis
(d) Describe the concept of God’s creation
(e) Clarify man’s responsibility for God’s creations
(f) Explain the importance of taking care of life and the environment
teaching_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the meaning of Bible and Bible Knowledge
Discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the classification of the books in the Bible
Brainstorming: Guide students to brainstorm on the concept of the Book of Genesis
Debate: Guide students to debate on the concept of God’s creation
Skills Lab: Guide students in manageable groups to identify living and non-living organisms existing in their environment and relate their responses on the man’s responsibilities for God’s creation
Discussion: Guide students to discuss and present the importance of taking care of life and environment
assessment_criteria: The Concept of the Bible and Bible knowledge is well explained.
The books in the Bible are well classified
The concept of the Book of Genesis is well explained
The concept of God’s creation is well described
Man’s Responsibility for God’s creation are well clarified.
The importance of taking care of life and environment are well explained
resources: The Bible, biblical videos, and chats, relevant biblical texts and commentaries

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of Creation and God’s commandments
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the Holy Scripture through the Book of Genesis
learning_activities: (a) Analyse the Fall of Man and its consequences
(b) Describe the history of the biblical Patriarchs
teaching_methods: Group discussion: Guide students in managable groups to discuss the fall of man and its consequences

Case study: Provide a case study on the history of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph. Guide students in manageable groups to discuss, summarize and present the history of Patriarchs according to case study
assessment_criteria: The Fall of Man and its consequences are well analysed
The Patriarchal History are well described
resources: The bible, relevant biblical literature, video the fall of man and its consequences and bible commentaries
The Bible, relevant biblical text and ICT simulation tools

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of Creation and God’s commandments
specific_competences.specific_competence: Use the Book of Exodus to understand God’s love and compassion
learning_activities: (a) Describe the Concept of the Book of Exodus
(b) Show how the concept of God’s love and compassion appears in the Book of Exodus
(c) Identify the consequences of not appreciating God’s
(d) Love and Compassion

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of Creation and God’s commandments
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate an appreciation of God’s commandments as outlined in the Book of Exodus
learning_activities: (a) Explain the Sinai Covenant
(b) Clarify God’s Commandments as stated in the Book of Exodus
(c) Show the indicators of Moses’ leadership qualities
teaching_methods: Guest speaker: Invite the knowledgeable person to provide knowledge of Sinai Covenant, then let the students discuss, and share their findings before the class
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw to clarify God’s Commandments
Group discussion: Guide students in groups to discuss, summarize and share the indicators of Moses’s leadership qualities
assessment_criteria: The concept of the Sinai Covenant is well explained
God’s Commandments as stated in the book of Exodus are well clarified
The indicators of Moses’ leadership qualities are well shown
resources: Bible, biblical charts and videos on Sinai Covenant, and ICT simulation tools

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of Creation and God’s commandments
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate an appreciation of the importance of statistics based on the Book of Numbers
learning_activities: (a) Explain the concept of statistics as revealed in the Book of Numbers.

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of faith by living a holy life
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the Holy Scripture through the Book of Joshua
learning_activities: (a) Identify the main ideas in the book of Joshua
(b) Use the Book of Joshua to discuss the importance of preparing leaders
(c) Describe the fall of the biblical cities of Jericho and Ai

Scenario: Provide a scenario on the fall of Jericho and Ai cities, Let them summarize and share their findings

The importance of preparing leaders are well shown
The fall of the cities of Jericho and Ai is well described

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of faith by living a holy life
specific_competences.specific_competence: Use the Book of Joshua to appreciate the importance of courage, bravery, humility, perseverance and patriotism
learning_activities: (a) Discuss the indicators of strength and bravery according to the Book of Joshua
(b) Use the Book of Joshua to discuss the importance of bravery, humility and perseverance
(c) Explain the concept of patriotism as appears in the Book of Joshua

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of devotion to God as revealed in the Bible
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate mastery of the Holy Scripture in the Gospel according to Luke
learning_activities: (a) Explain the term Gospel and Jewish institutions
(b) Discuss the authorship of the Gospel according to Luke (author, recipients and purpose)
(c) Discuss the themes of the Gospel according to Luke (salvation for all, the work of the Holy Spirit, worship and praise, the role of women, the Gospel of the lost and the Gospel of prayer)
(d) Identify the methods used by Jesus in his Ministry (parables and miracles)
(e) Use the Gospel according to Luke to defend human rights
(f) Discuss how the themes in the Gospel according to Luke relate to daily life (choose one theme for course work/ project to be submitted in Form IV)
teaching_methods: Debate: Organize two groups to run the motion about the Gospel and Jewish institutions Let them classify the books of the Gospel
Presentation:Guide students to discuss and present about the authorship of the Gospel according to Luke
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss and share themes found in the Gospel according to Luke
Assignment: Assign students in different groups to identify the methods used by Jesus in his ministries
Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw to apply the gospel in their daily life to defend human right
Project activity: Task students to relate the themes of the Gospel according to Luke with daily life situation
assessment_criteria: The term Gospel and the books of the Gospel, as well as Jewish institutions are are well explained.
The authorship of the gospel according to Luke is well discussed
The themes of the Gospel according to Luke are well discussed
The methods used by Jesus in his ministry (parables and miracles) are well identified
The Gospel according to Luke in defending human rights is well applied
The themes of the Gospel according to Luke and how they relate to daily life situation are well discussed
resources: Bible, biblical charts and videos, ICT simulation tool, relevant biblical books such as commentaries

Group discussion: Guide the students to discuss characteristics of the families found in the gospel according to Luke
Group discussion: Guide students in manageable groups to discuss the concept of good parental care
assessment_criteria: The concept of family is well explained
The characteristics of the families found in the gospel according to Luke is well discussed
The concept of good parental care as outlined in the gospel according to Luke is well discussed
resources: Bible, relevant biblical books, commentaries and videos on family life

Jigsaw: Guide students through jigsaw to explore the use of the Book of the Acts of the Apostles in defending human rights

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of devotion to God as revealed in the Bible
specific_competences.specific_competence: Demonstrate an appreciation of devotion to spreading the Gospel
learning_activities: (a) Use the Book of the Acts of the Apostles to discuss the commission and order to spread the Gospel
(b) Explain the role of the Holy Spirit in spreading the Gospel
(a) Describe the life of the early Christian community and their role in spreading the Gospel
(b) Discuss the acts of courage as revealed in the Book of the Acts of the Apostles
(c) Discuss Saul’s conversion and his missionary journeys
teaching_methods: Group discussion: Use group discussion to identify the commission and order in spreading the Gospel
Think-pair-share: Guide students to think-pair-share the role of the Holy Spirit in spreading the Gospel
Scenario: Use a scenario to describe the life of the early Christian Church
Group discussion: Guide students through group discussion to identify the Acts of Courage as seen in the Book of the Acts of the Apostles
Debate: Lead students through debate to discuss Saul’s conver- sion and his missionary Journeys
assessment_criteria: The commission and order in spreading the Gospel as shown in the book of the Acts of the Apostle are well identified
The role of the Holy Spirit in spreading the Gospel is well explained
The life of the early Christian community in spreading the Gospel is well described
Acts of Courage (boldness) as seen in the book of Acts of the Apostles are well discussed
Saul’s conversion and his missionary journeys are well discussed .
resources: Bible, biblical charts, ICT simulation tool, relevant biblical books and commentaries

specific_competences.main_competence: Demonstrate an understanding of devotion to God as revealed in the Bible
specific_competences.specific_competence: Use the Book of Acts of the Apostles to appreciate the importance of justice, peace and equality
learning_activities: (a) Determine the resolution of conflicts during the growth of the early Church
(b) Discuss the importance, functions and qualities of deacons used in the early Church
(c) Discuss the methods used by the Jerusa- lem Council to solve con- flict and bring peace, equality and unity in the early Church
teaching_methods: Guest speaker: Use a resourceful person to present the resolutions of Jerusalem council
Group discussion: Guide students to discuss the reasons and qualities used in find- ing deacons during the growth of the Church
Role play: Guide students to do a play on methods used to solve conflict by Jerusalem Council
assessment_criteria: The resolution of conflicts during the growth of the Church are well determined
The reasons and qualities used in finding Deacons during the growth of the church are well discussed
The methods used in solving the conflict by Jerusalem Council to bring peace, equality and unity are well discussed.
resources: Bible, biblical charts, ICT simulation tool, relevant biblical books and commentaries
